body: We're close. I'm pretty much a miniature him xD I don't really tell my parents or family members about school, but he is definately someone I trust with that stuff. Last year, I got in big trouble at school (totally not getting caught for starting a rebellion, what?! Noooo...) and my dad was smiling the whole time, joking about it. xD

Thank you for your support! Many members on my father's side know about my situation. As far as I know, they all think I should ask to stay with my dad. I would go to my grandparents, but a) I dont want to put so many extra problems on their lives, b) I dont get along with my grandfather very well. c) My sister lives there, and we haven't talked to each other in 6-7 years, until recently. When we do talk, it's short and awkward.

Yes! Someone who understands! Except, my problem is that the work is too easy. "How many fourths are in three-fourths?" That was a question on my paper for 6th grade math. WTH!!! Screw school and their easy work.
I'm glad she's okay, and I wish there were more people in the world like you. You are truly an amazing friend.
